component.name: Pekka Kana 2
component.summary: Jump 'n run game made in the spirit of old classic platformers

description.p: Pekka Kana 2 (Pekka the Rooster 2) is a jump 'n run game made in the spirit of old classic platformers such as Super Mario, Sonic the Hedgehog, Jazz Jackrabbit, Super Frog and so on.
The simple goal in each level is to find the exit sign, which is usually not that simple as it sounds because of enemies, traps, and quirky puzzles.
This release introduces major improvements since version 1.2.7.

ul.li: Improved general user experience (resizable window, more responsive GUI)
Various bug fixes and stability improvements
Added support for 3rd-party episodes packed as .zip files
Introduced a new level format enabling more complex and customizable 3rd-party levels
Removed other legacy limits (e.g. 50 levels per episode, 600 sprites per level)
Improved modding support with a more flexible sprite system (compatible with 1.2.7 content) and new Lua scripting support
